items.t: Upwork Stock Gets A Fresh Look After Earnings And Upwork Now Launch
items.sum: Upwork reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$185.6 million and net income of US$31.81 million, issued fourth quarter and full year revenue guidance, announced a CFO transition effective January 1, 2027, and introduced the public beta of its Upwork Now product.
